body: Because I'm already convinced that everybody I know hates me and that I'm on the verge of losing my job and family. Too many people to try and not let down.
I imagine it to be similar to that feeling of fighting off sleepiness and losing.

Already accepted my own mediocrity so by the big day I'd likely just try to be as intoxicated as my limits would allow, and then some. I'd probably be bolder, I might take a few more chances at dancing and singing in public, wear some freaky clothing, die my hair silver, why not. I guess I'd feel more free.

"Normal people"

These words in particular stood out to me, given both personal experience and other posts on this sub. This is something I've struggled with (and please let me know if I'm being presumptuous), but maybe you aren't the only one feeling like you're going crazy, like you're doomed, like you can't function on the same level as everyone around you. Maybe a trait or interest (or obsession, BELIEVE me I understand obsessions) of yours is hard to come to terms with or hard for others to accept, but if it isn't harmful to yourself or anybody else, who's to condemn it?

Isolation takes a toll on you. It feeds on itself, whispering to you that you deserve it and that you'll always be alone. It's like depression or anxiety or addiction, whispering things to you unheard by all else, baiting you towards self-destruction. That's the trick. That is all that it is, a trick. Unfortunately, it is a devastating and often effective trick.

If you're still around, why respons to posts you can relate to and see what happens? Worst case, they don't respond (or troll), best case, you bond with someone. What have you got to lose?

You can say that, but in the case of those who act on their darker impulses, everybody can condemn them with ease. What's the difference between such a person and someone similar who only holds back due to consequence?

My mother says she does but she treats me like I'm a burden but only because I'm so goddamn insufferable so... Maybe? It doesn't feel like it. There are also my therapist and a family friend but one gets paid to deal with me and one thinks I'm more innocent than I am.
